description: Pogranichnik (P5, examples/pogranichnik-p5.json: Thermite Cutter, Eternal Xiranite ×3) with Chen Qianyu (examples/chen-p5.json) vs Rhodagn; he starts with his ultimate charged. Chen's battle skill adds a Vulnerable stack, her combo's Lift a second. His ultimate raises the Shieldguard Banner (5 Steel Oath points, from frame 77). His battle skill's Breach consumes both stacks: 15 SP (atb2), a harass (a physical status in the banner), and his combo window with two stacks counted, so the combo plays the two-slash path, each slash bringing a harass. Chen's second battle skill and combo, after her cooldown, Lift the enemy again: the last two points (a harass, then the Decisive Assault), each giving her Fervent Morale (talent 2, 10 s). Every natural skill-SP grant of his adds a Thermite Cutter team ATK layer (two at most) and goes into talent 1's bank: Fervent Morale at 60 SP (P3).
